cases.name: dash-asks-for-four
cases.desc: A display device asking for the four values a lap timer shows. It names channels; it does not send an expression to evaluate.

cases.name: no-channels-requested
cases.desc: A device that implements the role but currently wants nothing. Legal, and the state before it has configured itself.

cases.name: unknown-channel-requested
cases.desc: A device asking for a channel from a later minor. A client MUST report it unknown, MUST NOT substitute another, and MUST answer the slot as absent rather than omitting it.

cases.name: first-lap-nothing-to-report
cases.desc: Mid first lap: elapsed time is known, but there is no last lap and no delta yet. Those slots are present-bit clear and zero -- a device that renders 0.000 for a last lap that has not happened has been told something false.

cases.name: second-lap-all-known
cases.desc: A lap later: every slot carries a measurement, and delta_best is negative because this lap is ahead.

cases.name: stale-value-behind-cleared-bit
cases.desc: A client that clears the present bit but leaves the previous value in the bytes. A device MUST report the slot absent on the strength of the bit alone, and a conforming encoder normalises these bytes to zero.

cases.name: empty-update
cases.desc: count 0. Legal: nothing changed. A device MUST accept it.

cases.name: short-payload
cases.desc: 3 bytes: shorter than the update header. MUST be rejected.

cases.name: long-payload
cases.desc: One value declared, one present, plus a trailing byte. MUST be rejected rather than ignored.

cases.name: count-exceeds-payload
cases.desc: Header claims two values, one is present. MUST be rejected.

cases.name: short-page
cases.desc: 5 bytes: shorter than the page header. MUST be rejected.

cases.name: long-page
cases.desc: One entry declared, one present, plus a trailing byte. MUST be rejected.
